title: sterculia apetala var. elata
intro: Sterculia apetala var. elata, commonly known as a plant in the Sterculiaceae family, is a type of flowering plant native to tropical regions. It is valued for its various health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Sterculia apetala var. elata include wound healing, anti-diabetic, and antihyperlipidemic effects. The bioactive constituents of the plant are primarily flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic compounds, although specific information on these constituents may be limited, further research is required.
